Split on whether n is in the subset: if n is excluded, the subset is a valid subset of {1..n-1}; if n is included, n-1 is excluded and the rest is a valid subset of {1..n-2} with residue shifted by n. So f[n][r] = f[n-1][r] + f[n-2][(r-n) mod 5], with f[0]=f[-1]=(1,0,0,0,0) (residues 0..4). Totals match Fibonacci numbers F(n+2) as a check.
